body.intent: Fix the gate step: the conductor default's gate runs rhiza check with the installed rhiza, not the PR head's build (SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA), so a change set that adds a CLI command, flag or setting fails the gate on docs/reference files its own build passes and hands back to conduct in a loop (runs 01M7DVV7GNJAWG29QZC5F2JWC3 and 01M7E56MGTY4M60XZNEG2A6537; request 01M7EAYSYK7Z32QRP0FB4XPKJN)
